title: Pakistan 🇵🇰 has more people than these 4 countries combined
headline: Pakistan vs *4 countries*
description: Pakistan against the UK, France, Italy and Spain combined. Who has more people? Real World Bank population data for 2025. Comment your flag.

ur.title: پاکستان 🇵🇰 کی آبادی ان 4 ملکوں سے زیادہ ہے
ur.description: پاکستان بمقابلہ برطانیہ، فرانس، اٹلی اور اسپین ایک ساتھ۔ 2025 کے اصل اعداد و شمار۔ اپنا جھنڈا کمنٹ کریں۔

segments.text: Pakistan against four European giants. This is Pakistan. Two hundred fifty-five million people.
Now add Spain. All four together. Pakistan still has more people. By almost nine million.
